# Christopher Bogart writes for The Times about proposed restrictions in the UK on the legal finance industry


November 26, 2025


-
-
-
-


In an op-ed for *The Times* , Burford CEO[Christopher Bogart](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/christopher-bogart/) writes that efforts to restrict litigation funding are misguided and would ultimately harm consumers, businesses and the broader UK economy by limiting access to justice.


Read more[here](https://www.thetimes.com/uk/law/article/stifling-litigation-funding-would-harm-consumers-and-businesses-mlj5nfzdh) .
